coaching_note: Add the Save Your Ass prep speech before quoting — it was skipped entirely on this call despite being the highest-leverage section for cutting billed hours; walk the customer through consolidating loose items and taking a carload before movers arrive.
phone_presence_notes: Consistently polite with regular affirmations ("no problem," "of course," "got it") but the call stays transactional with little rapport beyond the checklist.
audio_review_reason: Customer's responses are almost entirely monosyllabic "okay"s, giving thin signal on true engagement, and the rep used two different wrong names for the customer at the close ("Axia," "Dana") — audio would clarify actual tone and confirm what was really said.
